canonical_system.normalization_rule: normalize only for conditioning; preserve original unit, canonical SI unit, reference scale and transform identity

quantity_conventions.sign: signed coordinate or nonnegative magnitude as declared
positive by right-handed rotation about the declared axis; radians are dimensionless
one turn equals 2*pi radians; conversion must be explicit and reversible
oriented vector; right-hand rule with current
positive in the declared port direction
positive along declared conductor tangent or volume direction
orientation is derived from declared normal and trace jump
positive B dot n through the declared oriented surface
positive terminal potential or induced emf in the declared loop direction
positive into a load/thermal sink; source and return effects are ledger typed
absolute temperature; differences are also K
passive R strictly positive unless an active profile explicitly declares otherwise

frame_id.reason: fresh G2/T1 package must provide authoritative frame

handedness.reason: right/left handedness cannot be inferred from labels

normal_orientation.reason: surface and interface normals require ownership

canonical_default_for_contract_tests.scope: documentation and negative-control convention; not a future candidate default

n2_unit_turn_chart_observed.domain: rho in [0,1], theta_turn in [0,1], period_turn in [0,1]
n2_unit_turn_chart_observed.basis_semantics: positive poloidal/toroidal modes use cosine and negative modes use sine; toroidal phase is n*NFP*physical_zeta
n2_unit_turn_chart_observed.scope: source-owned screen slice only; full orientation/nondegeneracy remains unproven

transform_id.reason: fresh adapter must declare immutable transform

direction.reason: must be one of source_to_target or target_to_source

reversibility: apply(target_to_source, apply(source_to_target, x)) must round-trip within frozen coordinate tolerance
vectors transform by basis_matrix; covectors/metrics use the declared pullback; pseudovectors preserve handedness sign
a negative determinant is rejected unless an explicit parity/orientation proof and sign update are recorded
normal vectors must be transformed with the inverse-transpose and re-normalized only with a receipt

normalization.rule: original units and SI units remain in the ledger; normalized numbers cannot replace physical quantities

emf_and_sign_contract.static_flux_rule: static Phi with stationary coil does not create nonzero EMF
emf_and_sign_contract.negative_control: static field plus absent derivative source must resolve to zero or terminal_deferred, never invented voltage

negative_controls: B, J, K, Phi, V, P dimension mismatch
noninvertible or negative-parity transform without proof
normal transformed as a vector instead of inverse-transpose
